QuestInfo.name: Arec's Secret Letter
QuestInfo.1: Arec gives you a secret letter to be delivered to Lady Syl while stating that he will recognize the Dual Blades. Does the letter affirm his approval? Why does he want you to go see Lady Syl after becoming Lv. 55?
QuestInfo.2: When you delivered the letter to Lady Syl, she said that the Dual Blades have been officially recognized. She also said that the Dual Blades will now be able to make a job advancement like other thieves when they reach Levels 70 and 120.

0.0: Deliver this letter to Syl. You seem curious about its content. Be patient, as you will find out once you deliver it to Syl.

yes.0: I wish you a safe return to Victoria Island. I suggest that you reach Lv. 55 before returning to Syl.

no.0: Are you refusing the reward of your effort?

default.0: Don't forget to level up to 55...

npc.0: Please deliver my letter to Syl.

lost.0: Did you lose the letter that I gave you? You are more careless than I thought. I will write you another, but be careful not to lose it this time.
